tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250dgongs gter las rta glud gtang thabs bzhugs so: sa ma ya:1$0000300 rtsa gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo:

rta glud gtang bar: snod gtsang ma'i nang du dkar gtor dmar gtor dar snas brgyan: zas sna 'bru sna rin po che'i phye ma bcas bsham: rta glud dngos zangs sogs snod gang rigs su rta'i gzugs spar btab pa de 'dra mang du bzhag: changs bu gtsang ma dang zan changs sha dum glud rdzas sna tshogs pas bskor: glud nam rgyang bu 'dzugs: yi dam gyi bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas sngags drug phyag drug gis byin gyis brlabs nas: bde ba'i gdan la 'dug nas: na mo: dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro ste: rtsa gsum bslu med bden pa'i stobs: chos dbyings bsam mi khyab pa'i mthus: gtor ma glud dang yas rdzas rnams: mgron rnams 'dod pa'i yon tan mchog: ma tshang med pa rgya che zhing: rgyun mi chad pa 'byung bar shog: ting nge 'dzin gsal ba'i ngang nas: kyai: stong gsum stong gi srid pa na: snang zhing srid pa'i lha 'dre dang: khyad par drag po btsan gyi rigs: gtum chen 'bar ba spun bdun ni: mi dmar khrag gi ral pa can: sku la bse khrab dmar po gsol: bse yi lan phran sha ra ra: dbu la zangs rmog mchong ri gsol: sgro dar phod dmar tshubs se tshub: phyag g.yas btsan dar phya ra ra: phyag g.yon btsan zhags sga ra ra: bse phub dmar po rgyab tu khur: chibs su btsan rta dmar po 'chib: gangs dang la lung klung gi btsan: kha bzhi gdong brgyad la sogs pa: rigs dang btsun mo 'khor tshogs bcas: 'dir gshegs glud dang gtor ma bzhes: nad dang yams la dbang bsgyur pa'i: 'byung po glo bur ye 'drog bdag: rta drel phyugs la gnod byed kun: glud dang gtor ma len la 'dus: shu la rā dza sarba shu la bhū ta ā karṣa ya dza: aṃ ku sha dza: de ring sngags 'chang bdag cag gis: dka' ba mi las btsal ba dang: sra ba de ni brag la brkos: dkon pa rin thang gis 'jal pa'i: 'byung ba lnga dang rin chen lnga: 'bru sna lnga las grub pa yi: rta glud dngos las lhag pa yi:

'dod yon mthun pa'i yo byad bcas: lta ba'i yul du rab tu mdzes: yid kyi yul du dang re spro: nam mkha' dar tshon rgyang bus brgyan: snang srid lha 'dre khyed rnams la: 'bul lo bsngo 'o dgyes par bzhes: bdag cag yon mchod rta drel dang: phyugs kyi glud du 'di bzhes shig: sngon gyi lan chags byang gyur cig: 'phral rkyen gnod pa zhi gyur cig: byams pa'i sems dang ldan nas kyang: rkang bzhi 'phel ba'i phrin las mdzod: bsdu na/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlab: kha 'bar ma yi sngags kyis brgya stong sogs ci 'grub bsngo ba'am: rgyas par spro na: oṃ las snod mchog gtsang zhing dwangs pa'i nang: 'bru gsum 'od zhu glud rdzas gtor ma rnams: gang la gang 'dod mi zad 'dod dgu'i gter: bsngo 'o gnod byed rnams kyis thob gyur cig: tri shu la rā dza sarba shu la bhū ta a ka ro mu khaṃ sogs kyis bsngo: 'jig rten khams ni 'di dag na: 'gro rnams ma rig 'khrul pa yi: gnyis 'dzin las kyi snang ba la: che btsan dregs pa mi bsrun pa: btsan rgod drag po 'khor bcas dang: gdon bgegs log par 'tshe ba yi: tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad kyang: rgyal ba shākya'i dbang po yi: rgyu 'bras bden pa'i bka' la nyon: padma thod phreng dam ma bkral: sngags 'chang bdag gi bka' nyon la: yas glud 'di yis tshims gyis la: 'khor 'dir gnod pa ma byed cig: ri bo brag ri nags tshal dang: gong gsum mtsho dang chu klung sogs: rang rang gar bzhugs gnas der gshegs: 'byung po'i tshogs rnams gzhan du song: phyi mig lta bar ma byed cig: gal te bka' ltar mi byed cing: yal gam gnyan la 'da' ba na: dam tshig dmod pas sdigs par 'gyur: bka' yi chad pas brlag ta re: dam las ma 'da' sa ma ya: yi dam gyi sngags sham du hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags brjod la drag po'i thun gyis brab: glud dang gtor ma btsan gnas pa'i phyogs sam 'dre lnga bdud gcod kyi phyogs su phul:
srung 'khor bsgom: bkra shis brjod: de ltar rta glud btang thabs 'di yang dpal ldan thugs kyi rdo rjes dpal spungs kun mkhyen mchog gi gzim khang du dgongs pa'i gter las phyung ba dge: ྈྈྈ ྈྈྈ
